desc: Slide the Cybernet into action with a manual out-the-front mechanism. This all-steel design feels solid in-hand, and the bronze PVD button is satisfying and easy to use. Pierce through work tasks using the reliable D2 spear point blade. And when you're on the go, carry the Cybernet comfortably using a unique deep-carry pocket clip. It's clean, elegant, and the perfect OTF for everyday carry.
